product: Python json.tool, JSON Lines first use
persona: A command-line user validating two exported bookmarks
limits: Maintainer-run CLI exercise using Python 3.9.6 and disposable sample input. The retest changes the invocation only. No product copy was shipped and no human participant was recruited.
verdict: A first-use example for line-delimited exports should show the JSON Lines flag. The default validator rejects the valid sample, while the explicit invocation accepts both records.
experience_log: I feed the two exported bookmarks to python3 -m json.tool. It stops on the second line with Extra data.
I try python3 -m json.tool --json-lines --compact on the same input. It prints two normalized bookmark records and exits successfully.

tasks.goal: Validate the sample bookmark export using the default command
tasks.evidence: Exit 1. Stderr: Extra data: line 2 column 1 (char 34).

tasks.goal: Recover by explicitly selecting JSON Lines
tasks.evidence: Exit 0. Stdout contains both input URLs, one JSON object per line.

findings.title: A valid line-delimited export looks invalid on the first attempt
findings.observed: The default command handles one JSON value and stops at the second record. The error identifies the location without naming the input format.
findings.evidence: Pipe the two bookmark records from the README into python3 -m json.tool. It reports Extra data on line 2. Repeat with --json-lines --compact and both records print.
findings.impact: Someone following a generic JSON validation example may discard or rewrite a valid export.
findings.fix: In the first-run example for line-delimited exports, show --json-lines and explain that each line is its own record.
findings.retest: The command-level recovery passed on the same input. After adding the example, ask a new reader to validate the file without being told the flag and check that both records survive.

strengths: The failure identifies the line and column where the parser stopped.
Explicit input mode accepts the unchanged file.
to_verify: Whether a new reader can discover the right mode from the proposed first-run example.
Other Python versions and malformed lines.
